dataset: Sen1Floods11 v1.1 hand-labelled; test = 90 chips, bolivia = 15 chips (held-out event)

conditions.as_is: Data as provided (natural clouds and no-data included)

gated_fusion_unet_v2.description: Dual-branch gated-fusion U-Net, strong modality dropout (30 % optical removal, clouds up to 100 %)

otsu_vv.description: Otsu threshold on Sentinel-1 VV (per scene)

otsu_vh.description: Otsu threshold on Sentinel-1 VH (per scene)

rule_fusion.description: MNDWI where Sentinel-2 valid, otherwise Otsu-VH

hybrid_gated_fusion_unet+s1_unet.description: Hybrid: gated_fusion_unet + s1_unet where optical data are missing

hybrid_gated_fusion_unet_v2+s1_unet.description: Hybrid: gated_fusion_unet_v2 + s1_unet where optical data are missing

selection.criterion: mean IoU over ['as_is', 'cloud_50', 'no_s2', 'no_s1'] on the 'valid' split
